title: Day of the Week
description:
You are given a date as:

day
month
year

Your task is to:

Return the day of the week for that date

Possible outputs:
"Sunday", "Monday", "Tuesday", "Wednesday", "Thursday", "Friday", "Saturday"

Note:

January 1, 1971 was a Friday

Example 1
Input: 31, 8, 2019
Output: "Saturday"

Example 2
Input: 18, 7, 1999
Output: "Sunday"

Example 3
Input: 15, 8, 1993
Output: "Sunday"

Constraints:

Dates are valid
1971 <= year <= 2100
input_format: Read from standard input. Format details depends on the problem.
constraints: Please read problem description for constraints.
